title: eXoZymes Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Provides Business Update at 5PM ET today
summary: Management to host Q2 2026 update at 5PM ET / 2PM PT, today. Los Angeles, CA -- August 20, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - will host an investor webinar today at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, and provide an update on recent business developments.
body_markdown:
- *Management to host*[Q2 2026 update](https://video.exozymes.com/exoz-investor-update-2q-2026/join) *at 5PM ET / 2PM PT, today.*


**Los Angeles, CA -- August 20, 2026 -- Today, eXoZymes Inc. (NASDAQ: EXOZ) (“eXoZymes”) - a pioneer of AI-enhanced enzymes that transform abundant feedstock into valuable nutraceuticals and novel medicines - will**[host an investor webinar](https://video.exozymes.com/exoz-investor-update-2q-2026/join) **today at 5:00 PM Eastern Time to discuss results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026, and provide an update on recent business developments.**
